title: secrets: classify Store errors so callers can tell invalid input from conflicts
body:
The issue i have is `SecretManager.Store` returns errors that are not exported (`errInvalidSecretName`, `errDataSize`, `errInvalidDriver`, etc).
As a result, I cannot tell what status code to return in Podman REST API and most of the time status code 500 is returned while it's supposed to be 4xx.

I suggest adding `ErrInvalidArg` and `ErrSecretInUse` to `secrets/define` and return those in `SecretManager.Store`.
This way, I can use `errors.Is` to check whether the error is related to bad arguments or it's a conflict or internal server error.
